forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email associated with your account and we'll send instructions to set a new password.

errors.rateLimited: Too many reset requests. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a New Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Create a strong password with at least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in with your new credentials.
resetPassword.invalidTokenMessage: This password reset link is invalid, has already been used, or has expired. Please request a new link.

verifyEmail.title: Verify Your Email Address
verifyEmail.subtitle: Confirming your email protects your account and lets you claim past guest orders.
verifyEmail.successMessage: Your email address is now verified. You can access your account and claim any past guest orders matching your email.
verifyEmail.alreadyVerifiedMessage: Your email address has already been verified and is ready to use.
verifyEmail.expiredMessage: Your email verification link has expired. Request a fresh link below.
verifyEmail.invalidMessage: This verification link is invalid or has already been used. You can request a new verification email below if your email is not yet verified.
verifyEmail.missingMessage: No verification token was found in the URL. Enter your email below to resend the verification link.
verifyEmail.resendSuccessToast: Verification email sent if the account awaits verification.
verifyEmail.resendSuccessMessage: If your account exists and is still unverified, a fresh verification email has been sent.
